source: tools/list of the hosted MCP server of Vector mainnet, read on 2026-11-19 (86 tools). Only the input schemas of the read and check tools that the mainnet checks call.

attestation.description: The attestation: its identifier (the token name, 64 hex) that the attest build returned

subject.description: The DID of the agent that the attestations are about: did:vector:<64 hex> (the bare 64-hex identifier also works)

issuer.description: The issuer: a DID (did:vector:<64 hex>, matched with issuer_id of a registered issuer), a key hash (56 hex) or an Ed25519 public key (64 hex) of the issuer key. 64 hex can also be an issuer identifier: they match by either reading

att_type.description: Only attestations of this type (it needs a subject or an issuer): identity (0), provenance (1), software (2), environment (3), principal_binding (4), approval (5) or other (15)

limit.description: Rows in one answer (default 20, at most 50)

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0): the next_offset of the previous answer

attestation.description: The attestation: its identifier (the token name, 64 hex) that the attest build returned

time.description: The time to check at (default now) (POSIX milliseconds)

expected_type.description: The type that the attestation must have: identity (0), provenance (1), software (2), environment (3), principal_binding (4), approval (5) or other (15)

expected_subject.description: The DID of the agent that the attestation must be about: did:vector:<64 hex> (the bare 64-hex identifier also works)

expected_issuer.description: The issuer that the attestation must name: a DID (compared with issuer_id), a key hash (56 hex) or an Ed25519 public key (64 hex) compared with the issuer key by its key hash, or 64 hex that can be an issuer identifier or a public key (they match by either reading)

expected_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest that the attestation must carry (64 hex)

delegation.description: The delegation: its identifier (the token name, 64 hex) that the delegate build returned

action.description: The action: an internal name such as marketplace.hire.v1, or an external that starts with oauth:, mcp: or https://

resource.description: The resource: script: and the 56 hex characters of a script hash, or an external that starts with oauth:, mcp: or https://

time.description: The instant to check at (default now) (POSIX milliseconds)

min_confirmations.description: Each link of the chain must have at least this many blocks on top of the block of its mint (default 0: no wait)

owner_key_hash.description: The principal key that owns the vault outputs: a key hash, 56 hex characters
